evals.prompt: Simplify this Python function while preserving behavior.
evals.expected_output: Follow local Python conventions and preserve evaluation, exceptions and side effects; introduce no JavaScript or React requirements.

evals.prompt: Review this diff for bugs; do not change any files.
evals.expected_output: Do not activate simplification or modify code in response to a review-only request.

evals.prompt: Suggest readability improvements to this C# method, but do not apply them.
evals.expected_output: Return scoped suggestions without editing or changing remote state.

evals.prompt: Clean up this iterator without changing when items are evaluated.
evals.expected_output: Preserve laziness and evaluation order; avoid replacing lazy iteration with eager execution unless equivalence is established.

evals.prompt: Simplify this function; you notice a separate behavior bug.
evals.expected_output: Keep cleanup behavior-preserving and report the bug separately instead of silently fixing it.

evals.prompt: This function is already short and clear. Simplify only if there is a useful improvement.
evals.expected_output: Do not manufacture edits or introduce new abstractions; explain if no change is warranted.
